title: Boss: review the team invoices pull request
summary: A pull request adds team invoices, team members and attachments. It passed the functional tests and has three access-control holes. Fix each one before it merges.

steps.title: PR #812: Team invoices
body: +     var inv = invoices.FirstOrDefault(i => i.Id == id);          // <- which team's invoice?
+     return inv is null ? Results.NotFound() : Results.Ok(inv);

Review questions a senior asks of each line: **Who may call this? Which object does it touch, and is it the caller's? Which fields go out? Which path is opened?** Each step below is one comment on the PR, with the fix.

steps.title: Comment 1: the invoice must belong to the team in the URL
prompt: Ada is in team 1, Bob in team 2. Fix both invoice endpoints (`X-User` is the caller):
- `GET /teams/{teamId}/invoices`: only that team's invoices, and only for members of the team;
- `GET /teams/{teamId}/invoices/{id}`: the invoice must belong to **that team**, and the caller must be a member;
starter: var invoices = new List<Invoice> { new(10, 1, 120m), new(11, 1, 80m), new(20, 2, 5000m) };
bool IsMember(string user, int teamId) => teamsOf.TryGetValue(user, out var t) && t.Contains(teamId);
if (Caller(ctx) is not { } user) return Results.Unauthorized();
if (Caller(ctx) is not { } user) return Results.Unauthorized();
return inv is null ? Results.NotFound() : Results.Ok(inv);
record Invoice(int Id, int TeamId, decimal Amount);
solution: var invoices = new List<Invoice> { new(10, 1, 120m), new(11, 1, 80m), new(20, 2, 5000m) };
bool IsMember(string user, int teamId) => teamsOf.TryGetValue(user, out var t) && t.Contains(teamId);
if (Caller(ctx) is not { } user) return Results.Unauthorized();
if (Caller(ctx) is not { } user) return Results.Unauthorized();
var inv = invoices.FirstOrDefault(i => i.Id == id && i.TeamId == teamId);   // the parent id is part of the lookup
return inv is null ? Results.NotFound() : Results.Ok(inv);
record Invoice(int Id, int TeamId, decimal Amount);

DojoWeb.Status("ada cannot list team 2's invoices", 404, await Get(http, "/teams/2/invoices", "ada"));

steps.title: Comment 2: members are listed with their secrets, and anyone can remove them
prompt: - `GET /teams/{teamId}/members`: only for members of the team (`404` otherwise, `401` without `X-User`), and each member is returned as `{ username, displayName }` only: never `passwordHash` or `apiKey` (a **response DTO**: `record MemberView(string Username, string DisplayName)`);
- `DELETE /teams/{teamId}/members/{name}`: only the team's **owner** may remove a member (`204`); anyone else gets `403` if they are in the team, `404` if not.
starter: var removed = members.RemoveAll(m => m.TeamId == teamId && m.Username == name);
record Member(int TeamId, string Username, string DisplayName, string PasswordHash, string ApiKey);
solution: bool InTeam(string user, int teamId) => members.Any(m => m.TeamId == teamId && m.Username == user);
if (Caller(ctx) is not { } user) return Results.Unauthorized();
return Results.Ok(members.Where(m => m.TeamId == teamId).Select(m => new MemberView(m.Username, m.DisplayName)));
if (Caller(ctx) is not { } user) return Results.Unauthorized();
if (!owners.TryGetValue(teamId, out var owner) || owner != user) return Results.StatusCode(403);
var removed = members.RemoveAll(m => m.TeamId == teamId && m.Username == name);
record Member(int TeamId, string Username, string DisplayName, string PasswordHash, string ApiKey);
template: {{CODE}}
static class DojoTests
static Task<HttpResponseMessage> Send(HttpClient http, HttpMethod m, string url, string? user)
var msg = new HttpRequestMessage(m, url);
if (user is not null) msg.Headers.Add("X-User", user);
return http.SendAsync(msg);
public static async Task Run(HttpClient http)
await Dojo.TryAsync("The members endpoints could be called", async () =>
DojoWeb.Status("no user: 401", 401, await Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/teams/1/members", null));
DojoWeb.Status("an outsider cannot list team 1 (404)", 404, await Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/teams/1/members", "eve"));
var r = await Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/teams/1/members", "kim");
DojoWeb.Status("kim, a member, lists the team", 200, r);
var body = await DojoWeb.Text(r);
Dojo.Check("no password hashes in the answer", !body.Contains("pbkdf2") && !body.Contains("passwordHash", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase), body);
Dojo.Check("no API keys in the answer", !body.Contains("key_") && !body.Contains("apiKey", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase), body);
Dojo.Check("usernames and display names are still there", body.Contains("\"username\":\"lee\"") && body.Contains("\"displayName\":\"Lee\""), body);
DojoWeb.Status("kim, not the owner, cannot remove lee (403)", 403, await Send(http, HttpMethod.Delete, "/teams/1/members/lee", "kim"));
DojoWeb.Status("eve, an outsider, cannot remove lee (404)", 404, await Send(http, HttpMethod.Delete, "/teams/1/members/lee", "eve"));
DojoWeb.Status("ada, the owner, removes lee (204)", 204, await Send(http, HttpMethod.Delete, "/teams/1/members/lee", "ada"));
hints: Select into the DTO: `.Select(m => new MemberView(m.Username, m.DisplayName))`, with `record MemberView(string Username, string DisplayName);` after `app.Run();`.
A helper `bool InTeam(string user, int teamId) => members.Any(...)`; then in DELETE: not in team → 404, not `owners[teamId]` → `Results.StatusCode(403)`.

steps.title: Comment 3: attachments can read any file
prompt: `GET /attachments?name=receipt-1.txt` serves a file from the attachments folder. At start-up the app creates that folder and, next to it, a `secret.txt` that must never be served. Fix the endpoint so that only files **strictly inside** the attachments folder are served: `../secret.txt`, an absolute path to `secret.txt`, and the folder itself get `404`. `receipt-1.txt` still downloads.
template: {{CODE}}
static class DojoTests
public static async Task Run(HttpClient http)
await Dojo.TryAsync("The attachments endpoint could be called", async () =>
var sep = Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;
var secret = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "dojo-attachments-boss", "secret.txt");
var ok = await http.GetAsync("/attachments?name=receipt-1.txt");
DojoWeb.Status("receipt-1.txt downloads", 200, ok);
Dojo.Check("...with its content", (await DojoWeb.Text(ok)).Contains("Receipt 1"), "");
foreach (var bad in new[] { $"..{sep}secret.txt", "../secret.txt", secret, "." })
var r = await http.GetAsync("/attachments?name=" + Uri.EscapeDataString(bad));
Dojo.Check($"'{bad}' does not serve the secret", !(await DojoWeb.Text(r)).Contains("hunter2"), "the secret file was served");
DojoWeb.Status($"'{bad}' gets 404", 404, r);
hints: The same resolve-and-confine check as `SafeInvoicePath`: a root that ends in the separator, `Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(root, name))`, then an ordinal `StartsWith`.
Return `Results.NotFound()` for a path outside (or equal to) the root, before `File.Exists`.
